```{=html}
<style>
/* ── About BSA Hero ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.about-hero-section {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto 4rem;
  padding: 3rem 2rem 3.5rem;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #FFD100;
}
.about-hero-inner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4rem; }
.about-hero-left  { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.05; }
.about-hero-word  { font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem); font-weight: 900; color: #003B5C; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.about-hero-right { flex: 1; padding-top: 0.4rem; border-left: 4px solid #2774AE; padding-left: 2rem; }
.about-hero-right p { font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.9; color: #333; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.about-hero-right p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ── Shared section headers ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.section-block    { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto 4.5rem; padding: 0 2rem; }
.section-label    { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2.5px; color: #2774AE; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.section-title-bar{ font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #003B5C; margin: 0 0 0.6rem; padding-bottom: 0.65rem; border-bottom: 3px solid #FFD100; display: inline-block; }
.board-year-tabs  { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* ── Hex placeholder (before photo loads) ───────────────────────────────── */
.hex-placeholder  { background: var(--hex-color, #2774AE) !important; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; }
.hex-initials     { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.hex-placeholder .hex-label { opacity: 1; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.28); }
.hex-placeholder .hex-label .hex-name,
.hex-placeholder .hex-label .hex-role { font-size: 0.62rem; }

/* ── Newsletter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.newsletter-wrap   { background: #003B5C; border-radius: 20px; padding: 3rem 3rem 3.5rem; color: #fff; }
.newsletter-top    { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
.newsletter-logo-tag  { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px; color: #FFD100; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.newsletter-big-title { font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem); font-weight: 900; color: #fff; margin: 0 0 0.6rem; line-height: 1.1; }
.newsletter-subtitle  { font-size: 0.97rem; color: #a8c4d8; line-height: 1.75; max-width: 480px; margin: 0; }
.newsletter-stats     { display: flex; gap: 2rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.newsletter-stat-num  { font-size: 2.8rem; font-weight: 900; color: #FFD100; line-height: 1; }
.newsletter-stat-label{ font-size: 0.72rem; color: #7aa8bf; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-top: 0.3rem; }
.newsletter-issues    { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1.25rem; }
.newsletter-issue-card{ display: block; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none !important; background: #fff; transition: transform 0.22s, box-shadow 0.22s; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
.newsletter-issue-card:hover { transform: translateY(-7px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.38); }
.newsletter-issue-banner { height: 7px; width: 100%; }
.newsletter-issue-body{ padding: 1.5rem 1.4rem 1.75rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; }
.newsletter-vol-badge { font-size: 0.67rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #2774AE; border: 1.5px solid #2774AE; display: inline-block; padding: 0.12rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; align-self: flex-start; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
.newsletter-issue-quarter { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; color: #003B5C; line-height: 1.2; }

.newsletter-issue-cta     { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: #2774AE; margin-top: 0.85rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; transition: gap 0.15s; }
.newsletter-issue-card:hover .newsletter-issue-cta { gap: 0.55rem; }

/* ── Responsive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     RENDER SCRIPT — reads BSA_ABOUT and populates the page
     You should not need to edit below this line.
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function () {
  var D = window.BSA_ABOUT;

  /* ── Description ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var descEl = document.getElementById('bsaDescription');
  if (descEl) {
    descEl.innerHTML = D.description
      .map(function (p) { return '<p>' + p + '</p>'; })
      .join('');
  }

  /* ── Newsletter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var nlCount = document.getElementById('nlIssueCount');
  if (nlCount) nlCount.textContent = D.newsletter.length;

  var nlEl = document.getElementById('newsletterIssues');
  if (nlEl) {
    nlEl.innerHTML = D.newsletter.map(function (issue) {
      return '<a href="' + issue.href + '" target="_blank" class="newsletter-issue-card">' +
        '<div class="newsletter-issue-banner" style="background:' + issue.banner + ';"></div>' +
        '<div class="newsletter-issue-body">' +
          '<div class="newsletter-vol-badge" style="' + (issue.badgeStyle || '') + '">' + issue.vol + '</div>' +
          '<div class="newsletter-issue-quarter">' + issue.quarter + '</div>' +
          '<div class="newsletter-issue-desc">' + issue.desc + '</div>' +
          '<div class="newsletter-issue-cta">Read Issue ↗</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</a>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ── Slugify a name the same way profile filenames are built ─────────── */
  function slugify(name) {
    return name.toLowerCase()
      .replace(/'/g, '')
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
  }

  /* ── Find a profile path by name, tolerant of number changes ─────────── */
  function findProfilePath(name) {
    var idx = window.BSA_DIRECTORY_INDEX;
    if (!idx) return null;
    // 1. Exact key match (fastest)
    if (idx[name]) return idx[name];
    // 2. Slug-based scan — matches even when the trailing number changes
    var nameSlug = slugify(name);
    var paths = Object.values(idx);
    for (var i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
      var filename = paths[i].split('/').pop(); // e.g. "darren-lin-phd-50"
      if (filename.indexOf(nameSlug + '-') === 0) return paths[i];
    }
    // 3. Fallback: match index key by slug (handles apostrophe/case drift)
    var keys = Object.keys(idx);
    for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
      if (slugify(keys[j]) === nameSlug) return idx[keys[j]];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* ── Build one hex element ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildHex(member) {
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'hex-wrap';

    var initials = member.name === 'Coming Soon' ? 'TBD'
      : member.name.split(' ').map(function (w) { return w[0] || ''; }).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);

    var shapeHTML =
      '<div class="hex-border">' +
        '<div class="hex-shape hex-placeholder" style="--hex-color:' + (member.hexColor || '#2774AE') + ';">' +
          '<div class="hex-initials">' + initials + '</div>' +
          '<div class="hex-label">' +
            '<div class="hex-name">' + member.name + '</div>' +
            '<div class="hex-role">' + member.role + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    var profilePath = findProfilePath(member.name);

    if (profilePath) {
      var profileUrl = '../directory/profiles/' + profilePath + '.html';
      wrap.innerHTML = '<a href="' + profileUrl + '" class="hex-link">' + shapeHTML + '</a>';
      loadPhoto(wrap, profilePath);
    } else {
      wrap.innerHTML = shapeHTML;
    }
    return wrap;
  }

  /* ── Fetch photo from student directory profile ───────────────────────── */
  function loadPhoto(hexWrap, profilePath) {
    var profileUrl = '../directory/profiles/' + profilePath + '.html';
    var progType   = profilePath.split('/')[0]; // phd | ms | mdsh

    fetch(profileUrl)
      .then(function (r) { return r.text(); })
      .then(function (html) {
        var parser = new DOMParser();
        var doc    = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
        var img    = doc.querySelector('img.about-image');
        if (!img) return;

        // src is relative to the profile page (e.g. ../../images/phd/file.jpg)
        var filename = img.getAttribute('src').split('/').pop();
        var imgUrl   = '../directory/images/' + progType + '/' + filename;

        var shape = hexWrap.querySelector('.hex-shape');
        if (!shape) return;
        shape.classList.remove('hex-placeholder');
        var initialsEl = shape.querySelector('.hex-initials');
        if (initialsEl) initialsEl.remove();

        var photo  = document.createElement('img');
        photo.src  = imgUrl;
        photo.alt  = '';
        shape.insertBefore(photo, shape.firstChild);
      })
      .catch(function () { /* keep placeholder on network error */ });
  }

  /* ── Compute balanced row sizes ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  // Rules: no row of 1, rows never decrease toward the bottom.
  // e.g. 7 → [3,4]  |  5 → [2,3]  |  8 → [2,3,3]  |  10 → [3,3,4]
  /* ── Mobile row sizes: strict 2-1-2-1... honeycomb ──────────────────── */
  function computeRowSizesMobile(n) {
    var rows = [];
    while (n > 0) {
      var count = (rows.length % 2 === 0) ? Math.min(2, n) : 1;
      rows.push(count);
      n -= count;
    }
    return rows;
  }

  function computeRowSizes(n) {
    if (n <= 0) return [];

    // 1. Fill rows of 3
    var rows = [];
    var rem  = n;
    while (rem >= 3) { rows.push(3); rem -= 3; }
    if (rem > 0) rows.push(rem);

    // 2. If last row has exactly 1, absorb it into the previous row → max 4
    //    e.g. [3,3,1] → [3,4]  |  [3,1] → [4]
    if (rows.length > 1 && rows[rows.length - 1] === 1) {
      rows.pop();
      rows[rows.length - 1]++;
    }

    // 3. Sort ascending so rows never shrink toward the bottom
    //    e.g. [3,2] → [2,3]  |  [3,3,2] → [2,3,3]
    rows.sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });

    return rows;
  }

  /* ── Build hex grid with smart row layout ─────────────────────────────── */
  function buildHexGrid(members) {
    var grid  = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'hex-grid';

    var isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
    var sizes    = isMobile ? computeRowSizesMobile(members.length) : computeRowSizes(members.length);
    var cursor   = 0;
    sizes.forEach(function (size, rowIndex) {
      var rowEl = document.createElement('div');
      // On mobile: no offset class — CSS centering aligns single-item rows to honeycomb midpoint
      rowEl.className = 'hex-row' + (!isMobile && rowIndex % 2 === 1 ? ' hex-row-offset' : '');
      members.slice(cursor, cursor + size).forEach(function (m) {
        rowEl.appendChild(buildHex(m));
      });
      cursor += size;
      grid.appendChild(rowEl);
    });

    return grid;
  }

  /* ── Build board tabs + panels ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var tabsEl   = document.getElementById('boardYearTabs');
  var panelsEl = document.getElementById('boardPanels');

  // Dynamic years from data (newest first) + always append 2020-2021
  var years = Object.keys(D.board).sort().reverse();
  years.push('2020-2021');

  years.forEach(function (year, idx) {
    var isFirst = idx === 0;

    /* Tab button */
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className   = 'year-filter-btn' + (isFirst ? ' active' : '');
    btn.textContent = year.replace('-', '–');
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('#boardYearTabs .year-filter-btn')
        .forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
      document.querySelectorAll('.board-hex-panel')
        .forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = 'none'; });
      btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('board-' + year).style.display = 'block';
    });
    tabsEl.appendChild(btn);

    /* Panel — 2020-2021 already exists in the DOM as static HTML */
    if (year !== '2020-2021') {
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.id        = 'board-' + year;
      panel.className = 'board-hex-panel';
      panel.style.display = isFirst ? 'block' : 'none';
      panel.appendChild(buildHexGrid(D.board[year]));
      panelsEl.appendChild(panel);
    } else {
      var staticPanel = document.getElementById('board-2020-2021');
      if (staticPanel) staticPanel.style.display = isFirst ? 'block' : 'none';
    }
  });

})();
</script>
```
